22/11/25  

27F

Reason for visit  
C/O cough  

HPC  
Dry cough ~10/7 worse at night + with talking @work in hospitality  
Nil SOB chest pain wheeze haemoptysis fevers rigors myalgia  
Had mild sore throat early now settled appetite ok energy abit ↓ but still working full shifts  
Nil known sick contacts though lots of coughing customers  
Non smoker nil asthma/COPD nil recent o/seas travel  
Pt thinks maybe aircon + new cleaning chemicals conc@work  

STI hx (r/v from consult 2/52 ago)  
Seen 2 wks ago for dysuria + ↑ thin vag discharge  
Results from vaginal swab/urine NAAT:  
- Mycoplasma genitalium detected  
- CT/GC NAAT not detected  
- HIV Ag/Ab neg syphilis serology neg  
- Lab unable to do macrolide resistance assay  

Now still mild urethral irritation + ↑ thin vag discharge  
Nil pelvic pain nil deep dyspareunia nil post coital bleed nil fevers N/V abdo pain nil rectal sx  
One regular male partner last 6/12 condoms "most of the time not always" partner not yet informed  
On COCP regular 28–30d cycles LMP 10/7 ago not trying to conceive would like kids in few yrs  

Red flags  
Nil pleuritic CP nil night sweats wt loss nil TB contacts  
Nil vag bleed abdo tenderness systemic unwellness  

Meds  
COCP (ethinylestradiol/levonorgestrel) stable  
NKDA  

PMH  
Nil chronic resp/cardiac dx  
Nil prev STIs  
Other chronic issues on file not addressed today  

Social  
Works long hours hospitality late nights on feet financial pressure but can afford scripts  
Prefers minimal time off wants simple tx plan  

O/E  
BP 112/70 HR 78 RR 14 Temp 36.8 SpO₂ 99% RA  
Gen well looking alert talking full sentences occas dry cough  
ENT throat mildly erythematous nil exudate nil tonsillar enlargt nasal mucosa mildly congested  
Chest good AE bilat nil wheeze crackles  
CVS HS dual nil murmur  
Abdo soft NT  
Pelvic exam deferred today recent exam 2/52 ago  

Ix today  
Nil ordered re cough clinically URTI/post viral obs normal chest clear  
Path results from 2/52 ago reviewed as above  

Assessment  
1 Subacute dry cough 10/7 likely post viral URTI 2° recent URTI irritant component from cleaning chems ?contributing but low suspicion serious pathology nil features pneumonia  
2 Symptomatic Mycoplasma genitalium cervicitis/urethritis non pregnant female macrolide resistance status unknown high background resistance in AU → use doxy then moxi regimen per eTG  
3 Partner mgmt + STI prevention required  

Plan  

#1 Cough  
Reassurance likely viral/post viral nil indication abx or CXR currently  
Symptomatic cares simple linctus / honey warm water fluids OTC lozenges paracetamol PRN  
Adv avoid smoke/irritants discuss at work re ventilation + minimising strongest sprays  
Safety net  
- R/V/ED if fevers >38.5°C SOB pleuritic CP haemoptysis or feeling very unwell  
- If cough persists >4/52 or worsens will consider CXR + further w/up  

#2 Mycoplasma genitalium  
Tx as per eTG first line for unknown resistance  
- Doxycycline 100mg PO BD 7/7 THEN  
- Moxifloxacin 400mg PO daily 7/7 immediately after doxy course  
Checked nil allergy nil known QT issues nil QT prolonging meds  

Counselling  
Abstain from sex or use condoms 100% until both she + partner complete tx AND TOC negative  
Discussed risks cervicitis PID potential impact fertility advised urgent r/v if pelvic/abdo pain fevers abn bleeding dyspareunia or systemic sx  
Emphasised full course not sharing meds alcohol ok in moderation but avoid binge while on abx  

Partner mgmt  
Advised regular partner to be informed tested and likely treated given high transmission  
Suggested partner see own GP or local sexual health clinic (bulk bill options available incl Aboriginal health service)  
No condomless sex until partner assessed/treated  

Follow up / TOC  
Plan test of cure vaginal NAAT ≥14/7 after completing moxifloxacin  
Book f/u appt ~5–6/52 to check completion/adherence repeat M gen NAAT and broader sexual health contraception chronic issues  
Earlier r/v if worsening pelvic/abdo pain fever severe dysuria systemic unwell  

Preventive  
Recent HIV syphilis CT GC screen already neg 2/52 ago nil repeat today as nil new exposures  

Time  
15 min consult focused cough + STI result chronic disease review and routine scripts deferred to next R/V  

[Added 16:30 by Dr K Lee – pathology check]  
Reconfirmed Mycoplasma genitalium positive on original swab all other STI tests neg in Best Practice inbox  
Plan unchanged will chase TOC result when done  

Reviewed and co signed by Dr J Thompson
